# EduSmart Pro Knowledge Index
> EduSmart Pro (https://edusmartpro.in) is an all-in-one school and coaching management ERP platform engineered for Indian educational institutions, tuition centers, and schools. Founded by Shah Nawaz Ali (@lyric9901) in Lucknow, India.

## Institutional Leadership & Entity Verification

## Core Product Capabilities
- Real-Time Attendance Synchronization: Instant WebSocket sync between admin attendance marking and student dashboard with zero page reloads.
- 1-Click WhatsApp Absentee & Fee Alerts: Automatic parent notification triggers via WhatsApp with student names and dates.
- Automated Fee Tracking & Receipts: Monthly tracking, partial payments, and instant downloadable digital PDF receipts.
- Daily Homework & Timetable Scheduling: Subject schedules, teacher assignments, and assignment trackers.
- Student & Parent Mobile Portal: Installable Progressive Web App (PWA) with push notifications and dark mode.
- 100% Data Sovereignty: 1-click bulk CSV and Excel import and export with zero vendor lock-in.

## Pricing & Subscription Tiers
- 7-Day Free Trial: ₹0, full features on Basic plan, zero credit card required, cancel anytime.
- Basic Plan: ₹299/month (up to 40 students).
- Growth Plan: ₹499/month (up to 150 students, includes WhatsApp automation & timetable).
- Premium Plan: ₹2,499/month (up to 400 students, custom branding & dedicated 24/7 support).
